# Outreacher by Arenova

> Enterprise cold email outreach and sales automation platform by Arenova (https://arenova.in).

## Overview
Outreacher coordinates multi-inbox deliverability rotation, AI-personalized cold email sequencing, autonomous B2B lead discovery, and deliverability warmup.

## Core Capabilities
- **Multi-Inbox Rotation**: Connect multiple Google Workspace, Gmail, and custom SMTP inboxes. Send jobs cycle across inboxes with strict 15–18 emails/day per-account limits and 15-minute staggered intervals.
- **AI-Powered Draft Generation**: Generates emails with Google Gemini and automatic OpenAI fallback. Claims are validated against extracted business signals with zero hallucinated claims.
- **Follow-Up Sequencing**: Multi-step campaigns enforce same-inbox replies with native RFC In-Reply-To and References message headers. Sequences stop automatically upon reply.
- **B2B Lead Discovery**: Prospect discovery via Google Places and OpenStreetMap Overpass with automated website friction checks and 0–100 lead qualification scoring.
- **Automated Warmup**: Controlled peer exchange with progressive ramp-up to maximize domain and mailbox reputation.
- **Anti-Spam & Compliance**: HMAC-SHA256 signed one-click unsubscribe links, global suppression tables, and automated bounce/mailer-daemon cleanup.
